rules.reason: The product surface is removed; retain only absence and dependency audits.
Compositor, OS input, or raster behavior requires a real native boundary.
PTY, history, process, and reconnect truth belongs to the daemon/runtime core.
Transport generations and subscriptions are verified at the protocol/runtime seam.
Workspace, filesystem, and Git outcomes require authoritative service read-back.
Remaining user-visible state is characterized as renderer state and accessibility contracts.
